scope: Independent narrow review of all24 completed reports: all72 price claims, and90 SSO-related claims including18 in other dimensions, against their own immutable frozen sources. method: Manually examined final statement/value/conditions and frozen evidence; exact-quote checks and targeted offline guard probes assist but do not substitute for semantic review. Reviewed report SHA256 values rechecked unchanged when this summary was written.
